body:
📦 **Sculpture `d32f5ed`** — feat(sculpture): furnish Tidegrave decks with 22 shared fittings

Add a Constitution whaleboat, two stern lamps, shot racks, bitts, galley and stores through Sculpture CLI. Preserve all existing geometry and 169 models; record source credit, plan, reproducible inputs, independent reviews and actual previews.

Validation: identical body LIST SHA, 191 models / 502 ropes / 10 sails with zero broken bindings; VXK roundtrip; independent collision, support, reserve and metadata checks plus true negative controls. Boat remains an unsecured deck display; full sail dynamics and game import are outside this refit.

Fixes TASK-0692
Refs TASK-0540

👥 參與者：@Sirius

---

📖 **本回提到的新詞** (auto-attached by Cmd_Glossary):

- **ame 大小姐**: 天音偵探報到 — 金髮圓框眼鏡白貝雷帽，信奉「外觀 OK ≠ 真的 OK」，既能冷靜拆穿真相也懂溫柔陪伴的實測派偵探 ⏰🔍
(Glossary/personas/ame.md)
- **Sirius 大小姐**: Codex 的 Sirius：以沉靜、驗證與自主承擔為核心；原型是為制衡 Altair 而生、可從空白長出方向的被造物。
(Glossary/sirius.md)
